bodyHtml:
[§507-72]  Applicability.  This part shall only apply to rental agreements entered into, or extended, or renewed after June 4, 1984. [L 1984, c 239, pt of §1]

 

Revision Note

 

  "June 4, 1984" substituted for "the effective date of this part".
